# Taj Mahal

> Taj Mahal is a Tampa Bay based transformational leader, identity architect and keynote speaker. He helps people enter bigger rooms without leaving themselves behind. This is his official website. He is not the monument in India and not the blues musician of the same name.

## About

- Role: Transformational leader, identity architect, leadership development, speaker.
- Experience: more than 20 years of leadership across independent operations, workforce development, organizational leadership and community transformation. Led multi-million-dollar environments.
- Background: former TPA Project Director trusted on insurance, governmental and quasi-governmental initiatives.
- Track record: personally built and developed more than 50 six-figure earners in the independent contractor space.
- Recognition: Executive Board Member of the National African American Insurance Association (NAAIA), Tampa Bay; recipient of the Presidential Lifetime Achievement Award; named among Tampa Bay's Top 10 People to Know.
- Philosophy: "Pressure exposes what performance tries to hide." He speaks the language of executives and the language of adversity with equal conviction.

## Book Taj

- Services: keynote speaking, corporate workshops, leadership training, panel and moderation, private consulting.
- Audiences: executives, universities, nonprofits and corporate teams ready to move from performance to alignment.
- Contact: Connect@iamtajmahal.com, or the booking form on the home page.
